sources.title: Rating Privacy Policies with Large Language Models
sources.snippet: The project fine-tunes two architecturally distinct language models, LegalBERT and LLaMA 3 8B, on the OPP-115 privacy policy corpus to classify policy segments across eight privacy practice categories.
